create_SQLContext: create a SQLContext with polars DataFrames, pandas DataFrames, and pyarrow Tables as SQL tables
run_SQLContext_execute: run a SQL query against registered polars and pandas frames in a SQLContext
run_SQLContext_execute_global: run a SQL query that auto-registers compatible frames from the current globals scope
register_SQLContext_tables: register multiple polars and pandas frames as named SQL tables in a SQLContext
list_SQLContext_tables: list all registered table names in a SQLContext
unregister_SQLContext_tables: unregister one or more named tables from a SQLContext
